env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A spread literal lowers in every statement and expression position:
# the arguments of a call-form child (copied before the source changes), the body of a block child, the
# children of a limited group, a scope defer call, an errdefer call, a
# select clause body, a labeled loop, a defer call argument, each case of
# a type switch, each arm of a switch expression, the init and post of
# for, if and switch, a chain stage lambda that runs in order and one that
# runs concurrently, a send, elided composite elements, map keys and
# values, a range expression, a switch tag and case, a return operand, an
# interface conversion and a condition. The module runs natively, ejects,
# and the ejected module builds and runs with go and with go1.27.2 from
# $UPROOT1272 and prints the same ok lines.
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/spread_statement_positions.lgo m/main.lgo
cd m
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/spread_statement_positions.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/spread_statement_positions.out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/spread_statement_positions.out
cd ../..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/spreadstatementpositions

go 1.27
